description_en: Queries the apps of a user. App information is returned only to the app owner
description_zh: 查询应用列表，非APP拥有者会隐藏APP的信息
name: DescribeApps

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account of the app owner. For more information, see [Account Management](https://account.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.15.3a8c196eVWxvQB#/secure)
parameters.help_zh: App拥有者的阿里云账号ID（账号ID请到[账号管理](https://account.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.15.3a8c196eVWxvQB#/secure)页面查看）
parameters.name: app_owner

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的页码，默认是1，起始是1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时每页行数，最大值100，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size
